description.value: As a full round action, quadav may retract their body into their shell. This allows them to gain DR/5 Bludgeoning. It also allows for 20% concealment. When they use this ability, they immediately fall prone, drop anything they were holding, and any item that isn't directly attached to their skin. While they are in this form, they cannot make attacks, use items, or cast spells. They must remain in this form for at least one complete round. To come out of their shell, they must spend another full round action (this does not provoke AoO).

effect: Drop held and unattached items and fall prone. DR 5/bludgeoning and 20% concealment; no attacks, items, or spells. Remain withdrawn at least one complete round. Enter or leave as a full-round action; emerging does not provoke.
Incoming attack: [[1d100]]. A result of 1-20 misses from concealment. Apply DR 5 unless the damage bypasses it.

description.value: Quick Cast

effect: Cast a red mage spell of 6th level or below with normal casting time of a standard action or less as a swift action.

description.value: Ruby Arcana
Spell Combat

effect: A free off hand and a one-handed weapon are required. Make the weapon attack and cast a standard-action red mage spell in either order. Selected Spell Combat Expertise +2 cancels the usual -2 penalty.

description.value: Spellstrike

effect: Deliver an eligible touch spell with this melee hit. Roll spell effect separately on a hit. Weapon uses its normal threat; spell damage is x2 on critical.

description.value: Red Mage Ruby Arcana: spend one arcane pool point for a Charisma-based insight bonus to attacks until the end of the current turn. The Pathfinder magus pack's Intelligence option is not this arcana.

effect: Use the Arcane Accuracy option on Arcane Pool to spend one point, then toggle the insight bonus until the end of this turn.
